import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server.ts";
import { v } from "convex/values";
import { sha256Hex } from "../../lib/crypto.ts";
export const seed = mutation({ args: { userId: v.string(), count: v.number() }, returns: v.null(), handler: async (ctx, { userId, count }) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const address = `${userId}-${i}@example.test`;
    await ctx.db.insert("verifiedEmails", { userId, email: address, normalizedEmail: address, isPrimary: i === 0 });
    await ctx.db.insert("challenges", { email: `challenge-${address}`, purpose: { kind: "addEmail", userId }, emailCodeHash: await sha256Hex(`code-${userId}-${i}`), browserSecretHash: await sha256Hex(`secret-${userId}-${i}`), expiresAt: Date.now() + 86400000 });
  }
  await ctx.db.insert("challenges", { email: `${userId}-0@example.test`, purpose: { kind: "custom", userId, purpose: "recovery-fixture" }, emailCodeHash: await sha256Hex(`recovery-code-${userId}`), browserSecretHash: await sha256Hex(`recovery-secret-${userId}`), expiresAt: Date.now() + 86400000 });
  await ctx.db.insert("challenges", { email: `${userId}-unattributed@example.test`, purpose: { kind: "custom", purpose: "test" }, emailCodeHash: "fixture-code", browserSecretHash: `unattributed-${userId}`, expiresAt: Date.now() + 86400000 });
  return null;
}});
export const counts = query({ args: { userId: v.string() }, returns: v.object({ emails: v.number(), challenges: v.number(), anonymous: v.boolean(), fenced: v.boolean() }), handler: async (ctx, { userId }) => ({
 emails: (await ctx.db.query("verifiedEmails").withIndex("by_userId", q => q.eq("userId", userId)).take(250)).length,
 challenges: (await ctx.db.query("challenges").withIndex("by_purpose_userId", q => q.eq("purpose.userId", userId)).take(250)).length,
 anonymous: !!(await ctx.db.query("challenges").withIndex("by_browserSecretHash", q => q.eq("browserSecretHash", `unattributed-${userId}`)).unique()),
 fenced: !!(await ctx.db.query("erasedUsers").withIndex("by_userId", q => q.eq("userId", userId)).unique()),
}) });
